articles.summary: WINCHESTER, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Trex Company [NYSE: TREX], the world’s largest manufacturer of wood-alternative decking and railing and a leading brand of outdoor living products, today announced the realignment of its North American distribution network.
articles.title: Trex Company Upgrades Distribution Network Raises Full Year Guidance

articles.summary: WINCHESTER, Va., July 20, 2026 – Trex Company [NYSE:TREX], the world’s largest manufacturer of wood-alternative decking, railing, and fencing and a leading brand of high-performance outdoor living products has signed a multi-year agreement with Fencing Supply Group (FSG) to become the exclusive national distributor of Trex® Fencing.
articles.title: Trex Selects Fencing Supply Group As Exclusive National Distributor For Trex Fencing

articles.summary: WINCHESTER, Va., July 09, 2026 -- Trex Company [NYSE:TREX], the world’s leading brand of wood-alternative decking, railing and outdoor living products, has been named to TIME’s “America’s Best Companies 2026” list. Presented by TIME and research partner Statista, the annual ranking recognizes companies that excel in financial performance, employee satisfaction and sustainability.
articles.title: Trex Named to TIME’s List of “America’s Best Companies 2026”
